new_value: Already fixed: router.c in lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/ fully implements RPL + Announce + LOADng dispatch. lichen_router_classify() classifies addresses (link-local, mesh-local, Yggdrasil, external), lichen_router_route() dispatches: link-local direct, mesh-local/Yggdrasil to gradient table (from Announce) with LOADng fallback, external to RPL parent.
